column2: The bold warriors of the Wood Wanderers hold eachother to a high standard of honor and provide mentorship if a member seems to stray. They are known to regard wild boars highly and their families will use totems of these fierce creatures to bestow strength and ferocity to their members.

Fianna are warrior bands that survive in the wild, raiding and protecting their homeland from invaders. Individual féinnid band together in groups of 9 or 27, forming a fiann. In addition to hunting, they also uphold filidecht, a sacred poetic tradition.

The Daymen seek to master the [egyptian_pagan_reformed.GetName] ideal of martial skill and companionship. Looking to the resourceful jackal for guidance and inspiration, the daymen work together in packs to master desert terrain and harden their minds and bodies.

The seasoned Champions of the Sun seek to uphold the Egyptian ideal of truth and justice, embodied in the word ma'at. Looking to the resourceful jackal for guidance and inspiration, the champions work together in packs to master desert terrain and harden their minds and bodies.
